calls.statement:
WITH sales_lines AS (
  -- Sales in Q4 FY2024/25 in South region stores (as-is)
  SELECT 
    f.sales_line_id,
    f.sale_date,
    cp.sku,
    cp.product_name,
    f.net_amount,
    f.standard_cost,
    cs.store_id,
    cs.region
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 40 AND 52
    AND cs.region = 'South'
    AND cs.store_id < 900
    AND cp.category != 'ZZ Test'
),
return_lines AS (
  -- Returns for these sales
  SELECT 
    fr.sales_line_id,
    fr.refund_net,
    fr.standard_cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line fr
),
product_margins AS (
  SELECT 
    sl.sku,
    sl.product_name,
    SUM(sl.net_amount) as net_sales_before_returns,
    SUM(sl.standard_cost) as cost_before_returns,
    COALESCE(SUM(rl.refund_net), 0) as total_refunds,
    COALESCE(SUM(rl.standard_cost_returned), 0) as cost_of_returns
  FROM sales_lines sl
  LEFT JOIN return_lines rl ON sl.sales_line_id = rl.sales_line_id
  GROUP BY sl.sku, sl.product_name
)
SELECT 
  sku,
  product_name,
  ROUND(net_sales_before_returns - total_refunds, 2) as net_sales,
  ROUND(cost_before_returns - cost_of_returns, 2) as cost_of_goods,
  ROUND(net_sales_before_returns - total_refunds - (cost_before_returns - cost_of_returns), 2) as gross_margin
FROM product_margins
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 10;
